name: mqtt-ovos-bridge
description: Make your Open Voice OS an MQTT device
author: trueflint

setup_notes.heading: Installation
setup_notes.content:
### 1. Clone the repository

git clone https://github.com/trueflint/mqtt-ovos-bridge.git
cd mqtt-ovos-bridge

### 2. Create your configuration file

mkdir -p ~/.config/mqtt-ovos-bridge
cp config.example.json ~/.config/mqtt-ovos-bridge/config.json

Edit `~/.config/mqtt-ovos-bridge/config.json` and fill in your MQTT broker's address and credentials:

{
  "mqtt": {
    "host": "192.168.1.x",
    "port": 1883,
    "username": "your_mqtt_username",
    "password": "your_mqtt_password"
  }
}

If your broker does not require authentication, you can leave `username` and `password` as empty strings or omit them.

### 3. Install

make install

This installs the Python package, registers a systemd user service, and starts it. If a config file already exists at the path above it will not be overwritte…

setup_notes.heading: Uninstalling
setup_notes.content:
make uninstall

This stops and removes the systemd service and uninstalls the Python package. Your config file in `~/.config/mqtt-ovos-bridge/` is left in place.
